properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-family digests in yarn.lock: every package entry carries an `integrity` field that yarn verifies against the registry tarball at install (~200 legacy entries still pinned with SHA-1 (`integrity sha1-...`), the rest SHA-512). This is the lockfile's supply-chain integrity control — real cryptographic use by the package manager, not a false match. SHA-1 verification is collision-weak (CWE-328 class) and worth inventorying even though SHA-512 dominates.
